digest.component_or_area: Jira DC test harness for rebar transport validation
propositions: The Dockerfile must be vendored locally and build FROM the addono base by digest, not pulled from an unpublished pycontribs registry.

The atlas-run entrypoint requires -DskipAllPrompts=true to avoid Marketplace v1 endpoint failure on every cold start, and -Dproduct.start.timeout to override Cargo's default 600s deploy ceiling that kills startup under emulation or resource contention.
The harness only works on native amd64 runners; emulated arm64 execution fails to reach REST readiness within acceptable timeouts despite pinned timeout overrides.
Personal Access Token authentication via Bearer scheme must be tested live against the real 8.17.1 instance, exercising the DC transport's auth mode against non-assumed semantics.
Teardown verification must poll direct issue endpoints (/rest/api/2/issue/{key}) for 404, never search queries, to remain independent of Jira's unbounded index lag per ADR 0037.

The harness must skip cleanly without Docker/instance, fail the canary if every test skips when one is collected, and require explicit REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1 opt-in to prevent accidental exposure of well-known admin credentials on loopback.
